tokens.theme.label: Colour theme tokens
tokens.theme.doc: One colour per token of the active colour theme (bg, surface, text, accent, …). A set is an override on the theme (kept per asset id); reset drops it.

tokens.style.label: Style theme tokens
tokens.style.doc: Fonts, base size, space unit, radii, border width, shadows, density, motion, blur, heading weight, tracking, transparencies of the active style theme.

tokens.layout.label: Layout tokens
tokens.layout.doc: Every layout parameter (core/engines/layout-rules.mjs): nav / inspector sides and widths, chrome switches, content width, status height, region gap, main paddings, phone edge and nav item minimum, viewport cut-offs.

tokens.typography.label: Typography tokens
tokens.typography.doc: typography@1: text scale, headings, weights, line heights, eyebrow, mono.

tokens.sizing.label: Sizing tokens
tokens.sizing.doc: sizing@1: buttons, icon buttons, chips, fields, tabs, segments, cards, list rows, count strips, tables, page heads.

tokens.look.label: Look tokens
tokens.look.doc: look@1 (core/engines/looktokens.ts): compact, row height, text size, corners, tone, motion, banner behaviour… The running app lists the ids; a set stores only what changed.

tokens.custom.label: Per-asset custom tokens
tokens.custom.doc: asset-customize@1 (core/engines/customize.ts): the extra tokens of every customizable asset type (button.radius, toolbar.iconSet, …), shared or per asset id.

tokens.slots.label: Active asset per slot
tokens.slots.doc: Which asset is active for each appearance slot (color-theme, style-theme, layout, button, …): set = hot-swap (runtime.swap), reset = the app default. Shared through the axHub look like every other look change.

amberx.items.label: AmberX notes, to-dos and tasks
amberx.items.doc: amberx-notes@1 items (apps/amberx-droid notes core): every note, to-do and task on every device. kind picks the shape; a task may have subtasks (parent) and a checklist.

amberx.lists.label: AmberX lists
amberx.lists.doc: The list tree items live in (Inbox and the plugin lists are system lists: they can be renamed, never removed).

planner.plans.label: Plan Studio plans
planner.plans.doc: plan@1 plans (console → Builds → Plan Studio): “put it in a plan for later” lands here as parked; `build` turns one into an orchestrator build.

planner.builds.label: Build orchestrator builds
planner.builds.doc: builds@1 records through the orchestrator (the one builds store; profiles are a field): every change is journalled, Pending / queue / Build manager are projections. build-todo-sync@1: act name sets the short name / category Brett references a build by; fix-add / fix-set / fix-remove keep its Planned & fixes checklist (mirrored to its Plan Studio plan and its to-do list).

console.screens.label: Console screens
console.screens.doc: Every screen (view) the open console has, its plugins' too. path = the view id, its title or words to search for ("plan studio", "builds"); act open shows it. Every console act takes optional input.to: recent (default: the console used last), all (every open console of the caller) or a client id (console.clients lists them).

console.dialogs.label: Console dialogs
console.dialogs.doc: Every dialog the open console registers (by id, title or search words); act open shows it (input.arg = its optional argument), act close shuts it (path "current" = whichever dialog is open). Every console act takes optional input.to: recent (default: the console used last), all (every open console of the caller) or a client id (console.clients lists them).

console.settings.label: Console settings tabs
console.settings.doc: Every Settings tab and sub-tab (Settings → Plugins → <plugin> is a sub-tab: its id, "plugins/<id>" or its title); act open shows it, input.anchor scrolls to one setting or group. Every console act takes optional input.to: recent (default: the console used last), all (every open console of the caller) or a client id (console.clients lists them).

console.actions.label: Console actions
console.actions.doc: Every registered action (the action bus: menus, toolbars, search). act run runs it in the open console under its own policy: an action that only navigates needs control.console.navigate, one that changes data needs control.console.write plus the permission the action itself requires, and a destructive one also a confirm token. input.args = its arguments ("swap:color-theme:dark" or ["color-theme", "dark"]). Every console act takes optional input.to: recent (default: the console used last), all (every open console of the caller) or a client id (console.clients lists them).

console.nav.label: Console navigation
console.nav.doc: Where the open console is (get here: screen, dialog, settings tab) and moving it: back (closes an open dialog first, else the screen before), home (the first screen), close (the open dialog). Every console act takes optional input.to: recent (default: the console used last), all (every open console of the caller) or a client id (console.clients lists them).

console.clients.label: Open consoles
console.clients.doc: The consoles open right now for the caller (one per browser tab: id, app, title, device, screen, last used). Console commands go to the one used last unless input.to says otherwise.

pass.scopes.label: Veto passes
pass.scopes.doc: Timed veto passes (control-pass@1): "allow everything for the next 30 minutes". path = the scope: all (the default: every command on every target and every call axHub holds, ordinary deletes included; irreversible deletes only with include_irreversible) or a narrow token scope (tokens.theme, tokens.style, tokens.layout, tokens.*: set / reset only). grant files a request the owner approves once; revoke ends it; undo rolls back what can be rolled back and lists what can't. The pass target itself is never covered.

plugins.commands.label: Plugin commands
plugins.commands.doc: Every command of every plugin, made automatically from what the plugin has (core/engines/plugin-commands.mjs): its server routes, its registered actions and its plugin.json commands. path = <plugin>/<command> (list names them); act run runs it with input = what it takes. A command that deletes needs control.plugins.delete and a confirm token (the same two-step flow as remove); an action runs in the open console like console.actions.

plugins.reads.label: Plugin reads
plugins.reads.doc: Everything a plugin lets you read: its GET routes, its data folder (data, data-file) and its info. path = <plugin>/<read>; act read answers it (input = its query).

tokens.nav.label: Navigation style tokens
tokens.nav.doc: nav-style@1 (core/engines/navstyle-rules.mjs): the navigation menu with sub menus: colours (colour-theme token ids), font, icons, density, width, the sub-menu animation, behaviour (one or many open, tap or hover, auto-collapse, remember, follow the active page, swipe), pinned / hidden / ordered items (comma-separated ids) and accents.<item id>. Only navs that opt in (nav-menu navStyle: true) read it.

token.note: the second word picks the token set: axf token layout get navWidth

console.note: axf console open <screen> | dialog <id> | settings <tab> | action <id> [args] | back | home | where | list [screens|dialogs|settings|actions|clients] [words]

pass.note: axf pass grant 30 (everything) · axf pass grant 30 --scope theme · status · revoke · undo (also `axf token pass …`)

plugins.note: axf plugins [plugin] | axf <plugin> <command> [--field value]… (every plugin's commands and reads)

tools.name: control_list
tools.title: Control: list
tools.description: List the tokens or records of a target (filters in select).

tools.name: control_get
tools.title: Control: get
tools.description: One token value or one record.

tools.name: control_set
tools.title: Control: set
tools.description: Set a token (an override on the theme) or change a record's fields.

tools.name: control_reset
tools.title: Control: reset
tools.description: Drop a token override (or every override of the target when path is left out).

tools.name: control_add
tools.title: Control: add
tools.description: Add a record (a note, a list, a plan, a build).

tools.name: control_remove
tools.title: Control: remove
tools.description: Delete a record. Needs a confirm token: the first call answers confirmation_required with one, send it back within 10 minutes.

tools.name: control_act
tools.title: Control: act
tools.description: Run a verb on a record (done, move, approve, step, …; control_list on the target shows them).

routes.body: a whole control@1 command (what the MCP tools and the CLI send)

usage: axf control remove <target> <path> [--confirm <token>]   (first run prints the token)
axf control targets | tools | routes | schema
axf pass grant [minutes] [--scope all|theme|style|layout|tokens] [--include-irreversible] [--reason why]   (everything by default; Brett approves it once)
axf pass status · axf pass revoke [--scope …] · axf pass undo [--scope …]   (also axf token pass grant theme 30)

aliases.console: axf console open <screen> | dialog <id> | settings <tab> | action <id> [args] | back | home | where | list [screens|dialogs|settings|actions|clients] [words]
aliases.plugins: axf plugins [plugin] | axf <plugin> <command> [--field value]… (every plugin's commands and reads)

path.description: token id or entity id (get, set, remove, act; optional on reset)

value.description: what to set (set) or the new record (add)

confirm.description: the confirm token a remove sends on its second call
